body: The single sharpest finding from the teardown. Prior art stores a random namespace in sessionStorage, which is per-tab by nature, so the namespace dies with the tab and a restored session can never find its old localStorage. That is exactly WHY no shipped extension offers save/restore. Deriving the namespace from the session/container id is nearly a one-line difference in the shim with the entire headline feature hanging off it. Write it down as a constraint before any shim code exists.
title: Design: key the storage namespace by session id, not by tab
